plan_summary: Navigate to the box stack, pick BOX_TOP (the only accessible box), place it temporarily on TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE from the box stack, place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and then pick BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back onto BOX_BOTTOM. This effectively removes the middle box and restores the top box on the bottom.
assumptions: The box stack is within interaction distance from the robot after navigating to its location.
The temporary table (TEMP_TABLE) is a suitable location to temporarily place BOX_TOP.
The robot starts at its initial position and can navigate to each location.
BOX_TOP is graspable and can be picked.
After moving BOX_TOP, BOX_MIDDLE becomes top of remaining stack and can be picked.
